text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening scenario and thesis","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a recognizable introduction that frames the issue and states a clear position right away."},{"evidence":"“Many individuals will argue…” / “Although all of these ideas are possible…”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges opposing views and responds to them instead of arguing in only one direction."},{"evidence":"“The only way to avoid this situation…” / “Clearly…”","quality":"conclusion development","description":"It ends by restating the position and summarizing the main reasons in a more complete closing paragraph."},{"evidence":"quoted article details woven into claims","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It incorporates specific information from the source article to support its argument more effectively."},{"evidence":"“This means that if the car fails…” / “This is addressed…”","quality":"reasoning","description":"It more often explains how the evidence leads to the writer’s conclusion rather than merely repeating facts."}]}
